data.value: When on, auto flip only moves the drag handle; component content keeps its order. Restart recommended after changing.

data.value: Whether the flip button for this position appears on screen.

data.value: Shows the current page and the total in the flip bar.

data.value: Scales the flip buttons at this position.

data.value: Page numbers often wash out on projectors and all-in-ones. Default is 17px, up to 40px.

data.value: Fade the flip bar when idle

data.value: After a while without input the flip bar fades so it stops covering the board. Touch it and it comes back.

data.name: Flip_FadeDelayDesc

data.value: While presenting with PowerPoint linked, the bottom toolbar dims after you stop writing and returns the moment you start again. Whiteboard mode is unaffected.

data.name: Flip_DesktopFadeDesc
data.value: In desktop mode, the bottom toolbar fades after a period of inactivity and restores on any input. Independent from the PPT settings.

data.name: Flip_MainBarFadeDelayDesc
data.value: Seconds after you stop writing before the bottom toolbar starts to dim.

data.name: Flip_MainBarFadeOpacity
data.value: How faint the main toolbar goes

data.name: Flip_MainBarFadeOpacityDesc
data.value: Lower is fainter. Keep it at 0.3 or above or the toolbar outline becomes hard to see.

data.name: Flip_PressFeedbackDesc
data.value: Highlights the button you press so you can tell on a projector whether the tap landed.

data.value: The switches above are fixed presets; the list below is a separate workflow engine. Convert them once and you can edit every condition in one place.

data.value: No presets are enabled. Turn some on above first.

data.name: Auto_PresetToWorkflowDone
data.value: Converted {0}. Workflows with the same name are skipped.

data.name: Auto_RestoreNothingToDo
data.value: This automation has not run yet, so there is nothing to restore. Press "Trigger" first.

data.name: Auto_ConflictNoCondition
data.value: Auto-restore is on but no valid condition is configured. Pressing "Trigger" will be undone immediately, because there is no way to tell when it should restore. Add a condition, or turn auto-restore off.

data.name: Auto_ConflictEmptyRule
data.value: This ruleset contains an empty rule (created but no type selected). Empty rules are ignored, so they do not act as a condition.
